newsitem.title: USA: International Alliance enters merger plan.
newsitem.headline: International Alliance enters merger plan.

text.p: International Alliance Services Inc said on Tuesday it had entered into agreements to acquire several companies, at a combined acquisition cost of 1,038,572 shares of its restricted common stock, $4,440,000 cash and a two-year $237,000 note.
Each of the transactions is subject to final due diligence and customary approvals, International Alliance said.

The company said the agreements involved the acquisition of the Ohio Benefits Group, the assets of Environmental Risk Insurance Co and Environmental Safety Systems Inc, the St. James Agency and a Cleveland-based human resource outsourcing and executive recruiting firm.

The Ohio Benefits Group, a corporate benefits administration company, will continue to operate under the leadership team of its founders, Timothy Paradiso, Jerry Batt and Mike Kurivial, International Alliance said.
"Our company opens a new market for IASI in the Ohio/Michigan region and gives us the resources to grow at a much faster rate," said Paradiso.
International Alliance markets environmental services, specialty insurance and bonding products throughout the United States and in Canada.
